text:
leo: Flagging GroveAI dispute on INV-2026-20245. They saw a $58,720.45 overage on Dedicated for 2026-04 after a sudden jump in reserved-commit charges.
carla-finance: any quick evidence? we need to know if this is vendor, infra, or product experiment related.
anika-product: short version: we ran a pricing experiment last week (flag: dynamic_peak_multiplier) to evaluate surge pricing on Hosted. A config sync bug accidentally propagated the flag to a small set of Dedicated accounts, including GroveAI. The multiplier 1.85 was applied to their reserved commit pricing for the window 2026-04-07T01:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z.
raj-eng: digging into audit logs. here's the config change record (sanitized):

``
2026-04-07T00:59:50Z,service=config-sync,author=anika-product,flag=dynamic_peak_multiplier,env=staging->prod,scope=targeted:test-cohort-5
2026-04-07T01:00:02Z,service=config-sync,replicate=dedicated,cohort=targeted:test-cohort-5,regions=all,applied=true
```

raj-eng: the replication rule incorrectly matched Dedicated resource tags because of a regex edge-case. We reverted at 2026-04-07T06:12:33Z but by then billing aggregation had applied the multiplier into the committed-cost calculation for affected accounts.
sofia-csm: GroveAI says this caused them to breach their committed budget and blocked an automated renewal trigger. They're asking for full reversal + SLA credit.
carla-finance: how big was the experiment effect on GroveAI? need math.
leo: raw billing snippet (sanitized):

```
line_item: DEDICATED_COMMIT_MULTIPLIER
base_commit_cost: $210,000.00
multiplier_applied: 1.85
billed_amount: $388,500.00
net_overage: $178,500.00
```

leo: their invoice shows the overage line as $58,720.45 because part of the multiplier overlapped with already-amortized commit and some of it was absorbed by monthly caps. The engineering reconciliation matches customer's number.
carla-finance: OK so this is an internal product experiment bug 97 non-vendor. We need to decide on crediting policy. Precedent: internal experiment errors generally absorbed and paired with a goodwill SLA concession if material.
anika-product: apologizing. This was my change; product will cover remediation. We'll also pause any further experiment replication to Dedicated until we have stricter scoping guards.
legal: for customer comms we need to avoid admissions beyond "we deployed an internal config that incorrectly affected your billing". Legal wants the customer message to offer remediation and avoid language implying contractual breaches.
sofia-csm: drafted customer message: "Hi GroveAI 97 we found that an internal pricing experiment incorrectly applied a surge multiplier to your Dedicated reserved capacity during a short window on 2026-04-07. We've reversed the experiment-related charges totaling $58,720.45 and issued a one-time goodwill SLA concession of $3,000. Your adjusted invoice will reflect these credits within 3 business days. We're also implementing technical safeguards to prevent recurrence."
carla-finance: accounting treatment: product-funded revenue adjustment. Proposed provisional entry: 

```
DR Revenue Adjustment 6105: $61,720.45  
CR Accounts Receivable 1200: $61,720.45
```

carla-finance: split: $58,720.45 reversal (non-recoverable) + $3,000 SLA goodwill (non-recoverable). Use GL 6105 (Product Experiment Adjustments). Need sign-off from finance lead + product + legal.
anika-product: product approves and will arrange internal chargeback to product budget.
raj-eng: ops action: we've added a config replication guard to stop flag propagation to Dedicated and a deploy will be out in 2 hours. We'll supply the deploy hash and audit.
legal: approve customer message with minor language tweaks, okay to proceed.
carla-finance: please react with :thumbsup: if you authorize posting the provisional credits now.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
anika-product: (reacts) :thumbsup:
legal: (reacts) :thumbsup:
sofia-csm: (reacts) :thumbsup:
leo: sending the message to GroveAI now and attaching reconciliation CSV. permalink: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01FINANCE/p1789990000000123
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-20245 status updated -> ADJUSTED (credit $61,720.45) / Reason: InternalPricingExperiment
carla-finance: logging the provisional GL entry and tagging: ProductRecovery/dynamic_peak_multiplier/ERR-EXP-004. Leaving thread open until AR posts and product budget chargeback is confirmed.
sofia-csm: GroveAI replied: "Thank you for the swift action. Please confirm when the invoice is final so we can proceed with renewal."
leo: noted. we'll follow up when AR posts and product confirms chargeback.
